import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Training samples: {len(train_df)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(test_df)}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_submission.shape}")

# Split training data into train/val (stratified by author)
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    range(len(train_df)), test_size=0.2, stratify=train_df["author"], random_state=42
)

train_split = train_df.iloc[train_idx].copy()
val_split = train_df.iloc[val_idx].copy()

print(f"\nTrain size: {len(train_split)}, Val size: {len(val_split)}")

# Author order for consistent labeling
author_order = ["EAP", "MWS", "HPL"]
label_map = {author: i for i, author in enumerate(author_order)}
inverse_label_map = {i: author for i, author in enumerate(author_order)}

y_train = train_split["author"].map(label_map).values
y_val = val_split["author"].map(label_map).values

# Word-level TF-IDF vectorizer
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    vocabulary=None,
    max_features=200000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    lowercase=False,
    token_pattern=r"(?:[A-Za-z]\w+|[\w-][\w-]*)",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    dtype=np.float32,
)

# Character-level TF-IDF vectorizer with increased max_features
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(3, 5), max_features=50000, dtype=np.float32
)

# Fit transformers on training data only
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_split["text"])
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_split["text"])
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(val_split["text"])
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(val_split["text"])

# Combine word and character features
X_train_combined = np.hstack([X_train_word.toarray(), X_train_char.toarray()])
X_val_combined = np.hstack([X_val_word.toarray(), X_val_char.toarray()])

# Train Naive Bayes classifier on training data only
model = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.03)
model.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Evaluate on validation set (proper hold-out - never seen during training)
val_predictions = model.predict_proba(X_val_combined)
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_predictions)
print(f"\nValidation Log Loss: {val_log_loss:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test data
test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])
test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])
test_combined = np.hstack([test_word.toarray(), test_char.toarray()])

test_predictions = model.predict_proba(test_combined)

# Create submission file with required columns in correct order
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "EAP": test_predictions[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_predictions[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_predictions[:, 2],
    }
)

# Save to submission folder
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")
